_comment: championLevelBonus is added to the travelling party's average level when a stored champion team is re-centered on it. gbaChampionTrainerIds are the League champion's gTrainers[] indices in the retail ROMs (pret decomps, include/constants/opponents.h), used on a home launch, where there is no Connect base patch: every id listed for a game gets the same team, which covers FireRed's one battle per rival starter.
